LabelPrimitive

Functional text label that names a control, with an optional required asterisk in danger. Small, Medium, and Large sizes in Regular (420) and Strong (625) weights, across Rest and Disabled states. Segoe Sans with size-stepped optical sizing (opsz 8 for S/M, 12 for L).
